articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Carrie Webster)
articles.description: In a rush to embrace AI, the industry is redefining what it means to be a UX designer, blurring the line between design and engineering. Carrie Webster explores what’s gained, what’s lost, and why designers need to remain the guardians of the user experience.
articles.title: The UX Designer’s Nightmare: When “Production-Ready” Becomes A Design Deliverable

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Eleanor Hecks)
articles.description: Poorly handled session timeouts are more than a technical inconvenience. They can become serious accessibility barriers that interrupt essential online tasks, especially for people with disabilities. Here is how to implement thoughtful session management that improves usability, reduces frustration, and helps create a more accessible and respectful web.
articles.title: Session Timeouts: The Overlooked Accessibility Barrier In Authentication Design

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: Practical guidelines for driving UX impact in organizations with legacy systems and broken processes. Brought to you by Measuring UX Impact, **friendly video course on UX** and design patterns by Vitaly.
articles.title: How To Improve UX In Legacy Systems

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Victor Yocco)
articles.description: Designing for agentic AI requires attention to both the system’s behavior and the transparency of its actions. Between the black box and the data dump lies a more thoughtful approach. Victor Yocco explores how to map decision points and reveal the right moments to build trust through clarity, not noise.
articles.title: Identifying Necessary Transparency Moments In Agentic AI (Part 1)

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: Design principles with references, examples, and methods for quick look-up. Brought to you by Design Patterns For AI Interfaces, **friendly video courses on UX** and design patterns by Vitaly.
articles.title: A Practical Guide To Design Principles

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Cosima Mielke)
articles.description: With the new month just around the corner, could there be a better occasion to freshen up your desktop?
